risks.note: Domestic/APM gas is in limited supply, and cuts to its allocation raise input gas cost. High international gas prices are a concern, and CNG prices are moving closer to petrol and diesel, which erodes CNG's price advantage. The chairman also cites rising input gas costs and energy market volatility during the year. Mitigation: buying through the Indian Gas Exchange and using index-linked, flexible contracts for short-term/spot purchases.
risks.risk: Natural gas availability and input price

risks.note: FAME incentives and Delhi's EV policy 2.0 are pushing EVs, which may impact CNG vehicles' market share in the medium to long term. CNG is IGL's largest revenue source. IGL is rebranding CNG as a green fuel and installing EV chargers at its CNG stations.

CGD is capital intensive: each new GA requires capex under the Minimum Work Programme and has a considerable gestation period before PNG and CNG customers are acquired. The company monitors each GA's profitability report frequently.
The MD&A states that operations are concentrated in the Delhi-NCR region, so demand depends on that region's density, urban infrastructure and industrial growth.
The MD&A states that the majority of revenue comes from CNG sales. That ties the business to transport-fuel demand and to the EV substitution risk above.

A data-security breach could cause unauthorised access, data loss or corruption, and loss of confidential information, with loss of strategic advantage or credibility. Mitigants: web application firewalls, data backup, cyber insurance, a 24x7 security operation centre and periodic third-party audits.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Domestic/APM gas is in limited supply, and cuts to its allocation raise input gas cost. High international gas prices are a concern, and CNG prices are moving closer to petrol and diesel, which erodes CNG's price advantage. The chairman also cites rising input gas costs and energy market volatility during the year. Mitigation: buying through the Indian Gas Exchange and using index-linked, flexible contracts for short-term/spot purchases.
- FAME incentives and Delhi's EV policy 2.0 are pushing EVs, which may impact CNG vehicles' market share in the medium to long term. CNG is IGL's largest revenue source. IGL is rebranding CNG as a green fuel and installing EV chargers at its CNG stations.
- CGD is capital intensive: each new GA requires capex under the Minimum Work Programme and has a considerable gestation period before PNG and CNG customers are acquired. The company monitors each GA's profitability report frequently.
- The MD&A states that operations are concentrated in the Delhi-NCR region, so demand depends on that region's density, urban infrastructure and industrial growth.
- The MD&A states that the majority of revenue comes from CNG sales. That ties the business to transport-fuel demand and to the EV substitution risk above.
- A data-security breach could cause unauthorised access, data loss or corruption, and loss of confidential information, with loss of strategic advantage or credibility. Mitigants: web application firewalls, data backup, cyber insurance, a 24x7 security operation centre and periodic third-party audits.

strategy.body:

themes.title: Oil & Gas - gas economy (CGD/LNG) + refining/upstream
themes.need: India's gas-economy push now collides with an outright policy reversal. ATGL grew volume 13% to 303 MMSCM and revenue 27% to INR 1,908cr, yet EBITDA FELL sequentially to INR 281cr (~14.7% margin, from INR 310cr) because the government withdrew the pooled-gas mechanism after the West Asia 'peace deal', pushing ATGL to ~15% spot volumes with Brent above $107/bbl; management also noted NWG price is 12% of the Indian crude basket, so a 62% domestic mix protects far less than it looks, and CNG station adds slowed to +5 from +25 in Q4 even as CNG demand grows ~30%. The same shock ran the other way for integrated refining: RELIANCE delivered O2C EBITDA of INR 17,000cr (+17%) THROUGH the Strait-of-Hormuz closure at 96-97% throughput while Asian peers ran 15-20% below capacity, with ethane+ROGC at ~70% of ethylene feed as distillate cracks blew out (gas oil $16 to $63, ATF $14 to $62). MGL/GUJGASLTD/IGL/IRMENERGY carry the same CGD margin squeeze; PETRONET/OIL/ONGC/IOC ride LNG-infra + domestic-gas; CHENNPETRO/MRPL ride GRM cracks; DEEPINDS/JINDRILL/SEAMECLTD on ONGC E&P capex; AEGISLOG/AEGISVOPAK add LPG/gas terminalling.
themes.driver: Whether the pooled/APM gas-allocation mechanism is restored (the single biggest CGD earnings variable); LNG spot price and Brent; GRM/distillate cracks; ONGC rig tenders & day-rates.
